verdict.rationale: Sill is a free, open-source screen-mirroring and remote-control app. It streams a Mac window or desktop to an iPhone or iPad, with no account and no server. It has no user data store for an AI to analyze, so AI-generated insights and suggestions from 'my data' fall outside this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any AI feature that would make the axis apply; the 'candidates' in the typing docs are keyboard input candidates, not AI suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
